text: Use when creating or substantially adapting a campaign, account, contact, event or product landing page, including a new project with a short user prompt.
Quote the actual user message, not the delegation brief. Choose reader, purpose and action from the request and available evidence.
note: Site A1: "The brief sets the goal, the reader and the offer. Keep to those." The site agent never sees the user's message, only the Head of ABM's brief and the session history.

text: A short account-page request does not mandate paired navigation logos, a demo, a pilot or a section count.

Read the whole research overview, following `next_offset` until it is null, then read only supporting claim families. Read relevant seller product/proof/voice documents from the supplied seller index.
note: Site: research arrives as files (research/overview.md, insights.md, claims.md); no paging.

text: Record missing capture/research as an acquisition handoff to its real owner; do not seed a replacement pack or start another research pipeline in design.

loc: 3. Write the argument and finished copy
text: Write the supported account context → seller mechanism → proposed application → useful evidence/evaluation → next action. Make it visitor-facing explanation, not an audit disclaimer or a generic feature list.
Choose one primary action's purpose, label and supported destination; source CTA styling does not dictate the offer.
Carry finished headings, descriptions, panels and all retained actions into the section records before assembly. Keep claim scope and limits internally.
Target identity belongs in opening content outside navigation; follow the campaign skill's explicit-user exception.
note: duplicate of L1b; opposite of site D3.

text: On an empty page, `assemble_cloned_sections` pins the selected released bands with their slot values. … No slot is not the same as no suitable component. Account relevance alone is not a reason to rebuild.
On a multipage request, create the named pages and complete one page at a time.
Verify the visible argument and every CTA promise/destination.
Call `finalize_web_run` with the actual result … Unverified typography, structure, missing content, inert controls or inadequate mobile coverage remain open
